script.title: Temple Above the Maples
script.description: A Japanese Buddhist mountain monastery: a vermilion-framed worship hall on a braced timber stage, a three-storey pagoda with a nine-ring sorin, an open golden Buddha sanctuary, and an autumn maple beside the stone approach.
